nodes.name: NiFe LDH supported on carbon Vulcan
Solvothermal synthesis of NiFe LDH
nodes.procedure: 79.6 mg of nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate [Ni(C2H3O2)2·4H2O] and 25.8 mg of iron(III) nitrate nonahydrate [Fe(NO3)3·9H2O] were hydrolyzed in ~2.4 and 1.6 mL of Millipore water respectively. The starting molar ratio of Ni/Fe is 5. Then the two solutions were added to a mixed solution of 30 mL of water and 16 mL of anhydrous N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) directly in the glass liner of a stainless steel autoclave (Roth, 100 mL/100 bar Model I). After 5 min of ultrasonication, the solvothermal reaction was performed at 130°C for 16 h followed by a second solvothermal treatment at 170°C for 2 h. Magnetic stirring was employed only for the first 30 min of the low temperature step. At the end of the synthesis, the autoclave was let cooled down naturally. The obtained suspension was ultrasonicated briefly and divided into two.

nodes.name: Carbon Vulcan supporting and purification
nodes.procedure: The obtained suspension was ultrasonicated briefly and divided into two. One half was mixed with 44.2 mg of carbon Vulcan powder (Cabot XC-72R) and ultrasonicated. After aging overnight, the suspension was washed with a centrifuge for two times in ethanol/water mixture and two times with pure water (8500 rpm, 10 min). The samples were then freeze dried overnight.

nodes.characterization_summary: Hexagonal NiFe LDH nanoplates decorated with smaller amorphous FeOx particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The synthesized NiFe LDH catalyst presents hexagonal nanoplate morphology, typical of well crystallized LDH materials (Figure 2 a–b). The NiFe LDH nanoplates are decorated with smaller amorphous FeOx particles.

nodes.characterization_summary: All reflections assigned to hydrotalcite structure typical of NiFe LDH; main (003) peak at 2θ=11.3° with d-spacing 7.8 Å; crystallite size 15±1 nm by Scherrer equation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All XRD reflections are assigned to a hydrotalcite structure, typical of NiFe LDH (Figure 2 c)... The main diffraction peak at the 2θ angle of 11.3°, labeled with the Miller indexes (003)... d-spacing, 7.8 Å... Scherrer equation estimates a crystalline size of 15±1 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: Average composition 73 at% Ni and 27 at% Fe.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ICP showed an average sample composition of 73 at% nickel and 27 at% iron.

nodes.characterization_summary: Local analysis shows ~13 at% Fe in areas with few FeOx particles; post-stability test Ni/Fe ratio = 3.3 with no chloride incorporation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the more local EDX analysis reveals that areas with few FeOx particles have a slightly lower iron content of ~13 at%. Therefore, we consider the value of 13 at% iron a more accurate estimate... No change in the averaged nickel/iron ratio (Ni/Fe = 3.3) and no evidence for permanent incorporation of chloride anions were observed by EDX analysis after this experiment.
